misconceptions.one-right-answer: Assumed only one angle can hit the target.

options.feedback: Flight time depends only on the vertical motion. It lands twice as far, in the same time.
options.label: It doubles too

options.feedback: Going faster sideways doesn't make it fall sooner.
options.label: It is cut in half

steps.prompt: If you throw with twice the horizontal speed (same upward speed), what happens to the flight time?

options.feedback: The flight time comes from vertical motion only: d and vᵧ don't belong together.
